physics_goals.quote: Though ArgoNeuT is primarily an R&D project, the data collected provide a unique opportunity to measure neutrino cross sections in the 0.1-10 GeV energy range.
physics_goals.value: Operate a liquid-argon TPC in the NuMI low-energy beam as an R&D project and measure neutrino cross sections on argon in the 0.1-10 GeV range

summary.plain: A small liquid-argon detector, about 170 litres, that sat in front of the MINOS near detector at Fermilab in 2009-10 to catch neutrinos from the NuMI beam. It showed that liquid-argon chambers work in a neutrino beam and made the first neutrino cross-section measurements on argon.
summary.technical: Argon Neutrino Test: 170 L liquid-argon TPC (40 x 47 x 90 cm^3, horizontal drift of 47 cm, two instrumented wire planes) in the NuMI low-energy beam just upstream of the MINOS near detector, which served as a muon range stack; physics run September 2009 - February 2010 (1.335e20 POT); first inclusive nu_mu CC differential cross sections on argon (PRL 108, 161802).
